text:
sam_partnerships: FYI — ACME wants a private-offer that ties a committed spend to a 'retention breakpoint' (tiered credits if 12mo active usage) and wants different channel mapping for marketplace vs direct. Need ops + legal + finance input. Thoughts?
olivia_sales: Oof, two things: 1) co-announcement timing with ACME's HW partner 2) how we map marketplace SKUs to our internal SKUs for billing. :thinking_face:
maria_product: Can you clarify 'retention breakpoint' — is that a minimum seat/month activity or consumption window?
sam_partnerships: They described it as "12mo active usage threshold" — if >75% monthly active usage they unlock renewal credits. They want the marketplace private offer to reflect that in the invoice routing.
alex_finance: We need to avoid SKU aliasing causing double counting. If marketplace SKU A maps to internal SKU X we must ensure committed credit consumption only once. Also need proration rules for mid-cycle upgrades.
nina_legal: Need to see draft contract language for the unlock conditions; also check marketplace private offer T&Cs — some marketplaces don't allow conditional post-sale credits. I'll ping marketplace legal.
kevin_ops: From infra side, weighty ask: routing billing events by 'channel' (marketplace vs direct) requires tagging at ingestion. We can add a single field `order_channel` in the billing event, but need to triage retro data.
olivia_sales: Also, ACME wants a softer fall-back: if marketplace private offer is rejected by the marketplace, they want an equivalent direct-looking offer with a slightly lower discount. That affects pricing bands.
sam_partnerships: Action items: - Maria: draft the SKU mapping & consumption measurement (by end of week) - Alex: list billing/proration constraints - Nina: confirm marketplace legal constraints - Kevin: feasibility of `order_channel` tag and backlog cost
maria_product: Quick draft snippet of SKU mapping i'm thinking of:
```
# sku_map
marketplace_sku: MP-ACME-1
internal_sku: IN-LLM-BASE
measurement: token_seconds
credits_applied_to: IN-LLM-BASE
```
kevin_ops: That measurement field looks fine. We should instead use `consumption_unit: token_usd` to align with cost buckets.
alex_finance: For proration: propose 'commitment_monthly_floor' + 'usage_offset' policy. Example: if commit=100k tokens/mo, and month usage=120k we apply balance; if 80k we don't carry forward deficit but track for renewal credit calc.
nina_legal: Marketplace note: AWS Marketplace requires credits be applied at renewal or via invoice adjustment, not as retroactive cashbacks. GCP similar. So wording must say 'renewal credit applied to next term invoice subject to audit'.
olivia_sales: Announcement: ACME + HW partner want joint press in Q1. We should avoid leaked SKU/pricing details; we coordinate marketing timing. :loudspeaker:
announcebot: Reminder: joint-announce checklist task created — link: https://redwood.example.com/tasks/ACME-HW-Joint-announce
sam_partnerships: Can we get a rough timeline? if we finalize by Dec 10 we can hit ACME's Jan 15 public date.
maria_product: I'll have SKU mapping & measurement doc by Dec 6. Alex, can you run the proration calc table by Dec 8?
alex_finance: Yep. I'll also add an example amortization table and a 'breakpoint' column for forecast.
kevin_ops: I'll prep a small ingestion change PR for `order_channel` tagging, but it'll be behind a feature flag. ETA Dec 9.
nina_legal: I'll circulate redlined contract language by Dec 7, but marketplace legal may need more time.
sam_partnerships: Great — we'll tentatively schedule a sync Friday 10am PT. If anyone can't make, DM me. :+1:
